website.note: site emphasizes commercial YUPELRI; pipeline content limited to ampreloxetine

pipeline.modality: Small molecule, once-daily oral norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor (NRI)

indications.indication: Symptomatic neurogenic orthostatic hypotension (nOH) in patients with multiple system atrophy (MSA)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, durability-of-effect, multicenter study with open-label run-in followed by randomized withdrawal
indications.trial_status: Active, not recruiting (primary completion 2026-01); topline data expected 2026
key_milestones: FDA Orphan Drug designation for nOH in MSA

marketed: YUPELRI (revefenacin) inhalation solution — once-daily nebulized LAMA for COPD; commercialized in US by Viatris/Mylan; co-promoted; Theravance receives profit share + royalties

excluded_preclinical: Other discovery-stage programs (none individually disclosed as in-human)
excluded_legacy_terminated: TRELEGY ELLIPTA royalty interest fully monetized (Innoviva-related); not in TBPH internal pipeline
Numerous historical respiratory / GI / pain programs across the 71 ctgov records, all completed/terminated/withdrawn
excluded_partner_owned: YUPELRI ongoing post-marketing studies (lead sponsor Mylan/Viatris, 13 trials) — relate to commercialized product, not new clinical-stage development
